name: Luce Descoco The 387th
source:
Level/Level Cap: 1/3
Skill Level(s): Merchant LV1

The Sultan of the mysterious paradise known as Shangri-La located somewhere in the Kinani Desert that separates Helman's southern border from the rest of the Continent.

[spoiler]Once a simple merchant who was relentlessly mocked for his ugly appearance, he found Aladdin's lamp while wandering through the desert and wished to become the king of his own nation. 

A deeply paranoid man, his distrust of other people caused him to drive all humans besides himself away from Shangri-La. For company, he surrounds himself with soulless dolls that resemble human women and spends all of his days living in empty pleasure with them.[/spoiler]
